text:
rachel: Vendor sent a heads-up: eu-west1 preemptible pool is showing high contention. They're going to enable a temporary preemptible throttling policy starting 2025-03-12 18:00 UTC for ~6h. Reserved/dedicated unaffected but on-demand preemptibles may be delayed. Link: https://vendor.portal/notice/NT-1254
sam: Thanks. Does that mean our fallback autoscaler will spin standby from the same noisy pool or will it prefer other regions?
vendor-bot: Throttle applies to preemptible instances in eu-west1. Standby fallback also uses same physical pool and may see reduced capacity. Cross-region routing available if configured.
rachel: Ok. Quick mitigation proposals: 1) mark all non-critical test projects as evictable so scheduler deprioritizes them; 2) route heavy sweeps to us-central; 3) request up to 2 emergency protections from vendor for CI projects.
leon: I'll add a runtime flag to prefer us-central for long jobs during the window. Small scheduler patch here (will open PR):
```
# scheduler override
project_overrides:
  proj-sweeps-1:
    preferred_region: us-central
    priority: low
```
ci-bot: CI heads-up: moving nightly matrix for proj-demo-5 to us-central at 19:30 UTC. Will post logs if any failures.
sam: Can we canary the evictable tag on proj-staging-2 only? I'll run a single smoke job tonight. If it delays and still completes, we proceed.
rachel: Yes, apply only to proj-staging-2 first. @vendor-bot can you confirm how many protections we can request?
vendor-bot: Support: we can protect 2 projects for short windows. Opening ticket #NT-1254. ETA ~90 minutes. Reply in ticket with project names to expedite.
leon: PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/2201 (draft) 0 reviewers. It adds runtime override + a small feature-flag `eu_preemptible_throttle_20250312`. Will not apply infra TF until vendor confirms protections.
ci-bot: Canary started on proj-staging-2 at 18:10 UTC, job ci-112233. Initial observation: job queued ~45s longer but ran and passed.
sam: Good signal. If vendor can't protect both CI projects, prioritize proj-ci-main and route other workloads out of EU.
rachel: I'll update runbooks and wait on ticket. Will post here when ticket returns. If we don't get protection in time, we flip runtime override at 18:45 UTC and move longer jobs to us-central. :thumbsup:
